1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2025.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2026

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi satu bilion lima ratus tujuh puluh

empat juta tujuh ratus sembilan puluh sembilan ribu ringgit (RM1,574,799,000)

daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

Rancangan Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2026 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi

maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 388,763,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 364,650,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 96,461,000

Perbelanjaan lain 233,472,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 491,453,000

JUMLAH 1,574,799,000

Dibuat 20 Disember 2025

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5(5); PN(PU2)58/JLD.24]

DATO' SRI RAMANAN RAMAKRISHNAN

 Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the Employees' Social Security

Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2025.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2026

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding one billion five hundred seventy

four million seven hundred ninety nine thousand ringgit (RM1,574,799,000) from

the Social Security Fund for the expenditure on administration of

the Social Security Scheme for the year 2026 is hereby authorized for the purposes

specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 388,763,000

Supplies and services 364,650,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 96,461,000

Other expenditures 233,472,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 491,453,000

TOTAL 1,574,799,000

Made 20 December 2025

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5(5); PN(PU2)58/JLD.24]

 DATO' SRI RAMANAN RAMAKRISHNAN

 Minister of Human Resources
